facts.raw_span: A 46-year-old Japanese woman
history of epilepsy
redness and swelling of the right breast
erythema and swelling in the lower right breast
Ultrasound revealed a 54 × 41 × 31 mm low-echo mass with partially unclear margins in the outer right breast
invasive ductal carcinoma (no special type), high grade, ER+, PgR–, HER2 3+, Ki67 70%
Whole-body PET-CT revealed increased uptake in the right axilla, anterior mediastinum, left pleura, and liver
consistent with cT4dN3M1 stage IV breast cancer
lesions nearly disappeared
clinical complete response maintained for 23 months
persistent headache
a 30-mm mass lesion in the right temporal lobe
